title: 02. Atari & Chain Liberties (28k–24k)
description: Count shared liberties of connected stone chains, escape multi-stone atari, and finish 2-step edge captures.

puzzles.title: Single-Stone Capture
puzzles.prompt: White's stone at E5 has only 1 liberty left. Capture it!

solutions.feedback: Clean capture! Filling White's last liberty at E4 removes the stone and secures the center.

wrongHints.default: Count White E5's empty orthogonal neighbors (up, down, left, right). Three are blocked—fill the last open liberty!

puzzles.title: Save Your Group in Atari
puzzles.prompt: Black's two stones at D4-D5 are in Atari (1 liberty left). Extend to gain liberties and survive.

solutions.feedback: Saved! Extending to D3 jumps your group from 1 liberty up to 3 liberties (C3, E3, D2).

wrongHints.default: Your D4-D5 stones have only 1 breathing space left at D3. Extend there immediately before White captures both stones!

puzzles.title: Corner Edge Squeeze
puzzles.prompt: Edge stones have fewer liberties. Put White's two stones at B1-C1 into Atari and capture them.

solutions.feedback: Nice! Stones on the 1st line have no downward liberties, so plugging A1 captures both White stones.

wrongHints.default: Look at the bottom-left corner intersection (A1)—it is the only remaining breathing space for White's B1-C1 group.

puzzles.title: Counting a 3-Stone L-Chain
puzzles.prompt: Connected stones share all liberties as a single unit. White's 3-stone L-shape (D6-E6-E5) is down to 1 shared liberty. Find and plug it!

solutions.feedback: Sharp eye! F6 cuts off the upper breathing space of White's 3-stone chain, reducing the entire group to 1 liberty at F5.
Sharp eye! F5 cuts off the lower breathing space of White's 3-stone chain, reducing the entire group to 1 liberty at F6.

wrongHints.default: Trace every empty intersection touching D6, E6, or E5. Only F6 and F5 remain open—strike one of those two shared liberties!

puzzles.title: Double Atari Trap
puzzles.prompt: White has two separate groups each sitting at 2 liberties (C5 and E5). Play the single fork point that puts BOTH groups into Atari at once!

solutions.feedback: Double Atari! D5 simultaneously removes the shared liberty between C5 and E5—White can only save one stone, so you capture the other!

wrongHints.default: Look at the intersection sitting directly between C5 and E5. Playing there threatens both White stones simultaneously.

puzzles.title: 2-Step Chase to the 1st Line
puzzles.prompt: White's stone at G3 has 2 liberties (H3 and G2). Drive it toward the edge so it runs out of room!

steps.feedback: Step 1 complete! Blocking H3 forces White down onto the 2nd line at G2. Now finish the capture!
Step 2 complete! Blocking G1 stops White from reaching the bottom edge—White is now trapped in Atari with nowhere to run.

wrongHints.default: Never chase toward the open center! Block the side escape route (H3 first, then G1) so the edge of the board acts as your wall.
